description: Consent is not specific to particular processing purposes or covers multiple purposes without granular options. Article 7 requires consent to be specific, and separate consent should be obtained for different processing operations.
applicability: Applicable when seeking consent for processing activities. Each distinct processing purpose requires separate, specific consent. Blanket consent is not valid under GDPR.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of consent forms and identification of bundled purposes or vague consent requests without granular options.
